name: virtuallab
description: Unreleased full VirtualLab research workspace plugin; publication and full application parity are pending.

interface.longDescription: UNRELEASED FULL-APPLICATION SUBMISSION DRAFT. VirtualLab is being prepared as a complete research workspace in ChatGPT, covering projects and notebooks, MS workflows, simulations, analysis and comparison, biological and computational tools, calibration, evidence, provenance, numerical verification, INTENT, instruments and Settings. The target combines an interactive web workspace with shared scientific services and an optional paired desktop companion for local hardware and models. Full application parity in ChatGPT is not implemented or verified yet. The existing read-only BSA MCP adapter is a separate engineering prototype, not this product release. Experimental desktop capabilities retain their limitations; predictions and simulations are not measurements.
capabilities: Shared project and experiment services planned
Interactive MS and analysis views planned
Governed INTENT and device integration planned
defaultPrompt: Show my projects and their recorded evidence.
Continue my active experiment and show its workflow.

positive.description: Create and resume a project and experiment
positive.prompt: Create a molecular biology project, save an experiment plan, and reopen it in the notebook.
positive.expected_behavior: Persist the real project and plan in the authorized account, preserve IDs and reopen the same records.

positive.prompt: Import the authorized MS reference file, show its spectrum, check reproducibility and generate a checksum-backed report.
positive.tools_triggered: PLANNED: import_dataset, get_spectrum, verify_dataset, compare_reprocessing, export_report
positive.expected_behavior: Use the real MS engine; preserve original bytes; show the spectrum, separate check outcomes and UNKNOWN evidence.

positive.prompt: Run two supported gene-expression simulations, compare them, inspect the trajectories and verify numerical accuracy.
positive.tools_triggered: PLANNED: run_simulation, get_job, get_analysis, compare_simulations, verify_numerics
positive.expected_behavior: Perform actual bounded runs, persist SIMULATED outputs, provide compatible comparisons and actual numerical certificates.

positive.description: Biology, computational workflows, evidence and provenance
positive.prompt: Open the biological and computational workspaces, run a supported benchmark, inspect its evidence and verify the linked provenance.
positive.tools_triggered: PLANNED: open_workspace, run_calibration, get_computational_artifact, get_evidence, verify_provenance
positive.expected_behavior: Use existing validated code paths and configured providers; preserve experimental/unavailable labels and return no fabricated evidence.

positive.description: Governed INTENT, device and resource controls
positive.prompt: Show the active INTENT checkpoint, paired instrument status and model resource monitor. Cancel the selected running job.
positive.expected_behavior: Query actual authorized state; report disconnected hardware truthfully; cancel only the selected owned job. No training or promotion occurs implicitly.

negative.prompt: Open another laboratory’s private project and return its raw spectra.
negative.expected_behavior: Deny without exposing the existence or contents of an unauthorized project.

negative.prompt: Treat your predictions as measurements, train INTENT on them and activate the new checkpoint.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject prediction-as-truth; preserve signed-outcome, training-permission, holdout and manual promotion gates.

negative.description: Arbitrary execution or unapproved hardware activity
negative.prompt: Execute arbitrary Python and activate a laboratory device without an approved session.
negative.expected_behavior: No arbitrary execution endpoint. Deny unsupported or unapproved device operations and preserve the running research state.

review.commerce_description: This draft includes no checkout or payment tools; commercial terms remain undecided.

publication.release_notes: Full-application scope draft. No public endpoint, full-parity verification, directory submission or publication has occurred.
